Prefrontal_Cortex.function: Executive function, impulse control, decision making.
Prefrontal_Cortex.adhd_impact: Under-stimulated; leads to difficulty prioritizing and sustaining attention.

Dopamine_Reward_Gap.description: ADHD brains have lower baseline dopamine and fewer receptors.
Dopamine_Reward_Gap.result: Seeking high-stimulation or immediate-reward activities to close the 'gap'.

Default_Mode_Network.adhd_impact: Fails to deactivate properly during tasks, leading to intrusive thoughts.

strategies.Dopamine_Menu: A pre-made list of 'quick wins' (5-10 min) to boost dopamine naturally before a hard task.
strategies.External_Structure: Using timers, body doubling, and visual cues to compensate for weak internal regulation.
